title: One Customer, Four Support Fragments
scenario_text: Castellan Retail's customer success team is preparing a health-score rollup for its enterprise account "Meridian Outfitters" ahead of a renewal QBR. Support volume looks impossibly low, and the CSM suspects tickets are scattered. In Zendesk, organizations are auto-created from the requester's email domain. Investigation finds four Zendesk organizations tied to the same customer: (1) "Meridian Outfitters" mapped to domain meridian-outfitters.com (312 tickets), (2) "Meridian Outfitters HQ" mapped to meridianhq.com (47 tickets), (3) "Meridian Retail" mapped to meridian-retail.com (128 tickets), and (4) an org with no name mapped to meridian.zendesk-partner.com (19 tickets) used by an outsourced IT helpdesk that files tickets on the customer's behalf. Salesforce shows a single Account "Meridian Outfitters, Inc." (one AVID/account ID, one MSA in Ironclad) with three verified email domains listed in the account's "Associated Domains" field: meridian-outfitters.com, meridianhq.com, and meridian-retail.com. The Okta tenant for the customer federates users from all three of those domains under one org. The fourth Zendesk org (zendesk-partner.com) belongs to a third-party managed-services provider, Brightpath IT, that is contractually authorized in the MSA appendix to submit tickets for Meridian; its tickets reference Meridian asset tags and the Meridian account ID in the subject line.
question: How many Zendesk tickets should be attributed to the Meridian Outfitters account for the health-score rollup?
